title: Scenario 1: Command & Control Beaconing
description: APT29 establishes command and control by sending regular HTTP beacons to external servers at consistent intervals. Learn to detect periodic network connections that indicate C2 activity.
mitre_technique: T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
hunt_for: Look for HTTP connections with regular timing patterns (beaconing). Focus on connections to unusual domains, especially those with consistent intervals between requests.
detection_tips: Search for HTTP POST requests to external IPs
Look for connections with regular time intervals (e.g., every 60 seconds)
Check User-Agent strings for non-standard values
